title: High refractive index, high Abbe composition
abstract: Copolymers produced from a mixture of reactive monomers and possessing both a high refractive index and a high Abbe number are disclosed. These materials are well suited for use in implantable ophthalmic devices, as they possess a refractive index that can be adjusted by applying energy. When used in intraocular lenses, the high refractive index enables thin lenses that can be compressed to allow for small incision sizes.
